newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on January 2:

WASHINGTON - Last summer, Giant Food Inc began making contingency plans for staying open during a possible strike by the Teamsters union. Now, with that strike underway the grocery chain already is planning for the recovery of lost business and profits once the dispute is over.

WASHINGTON - U.S. companies have caught jungle fever, bottling and selling, packaging and re-packaging just about anything with a rain forest theme, capitalising on the apparent soft spot in the American consumer's heart for protecting habitats.
